## 1. Professional Summary

Gaurav Kumar is a backend-focused software engineer with approximately 3 years of production engineering experience, primarily in high-reliability healthcare applications and developer tooling. He specializes in designing robust RESTful and WebSocket APIs, asynchronous event pipelines, third-party enterprise integrations (EMR, payments, cloud services), and developer command-line interfaces.

He emphasizes clean architecture, practical problem-solving, and system ownership. Rather than relying on superficial abstractions, he takes deep ownership of end-to-end reliability, database query performance, and developer ergonomics.

## 3. Work Experience

### Associate Software Engineer
**Company:** CognitiveClouds / Mahalo
**Period:** November 2022 – August 2025
**Location:** Remote (India)
**Key Contributions:**
- Led backend engineering across multiple client and internal software platforms using NestJS, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL.
- Collaborated directly with enterprise clients to translate business requirements into technical architectures and production-ready APIs.
- Built and maintained services for 5+ digital health and wellness platforms utilized by hospitals, academic research institutions, and healthcare providers.
- Engineered core business modules including appointment scheduling engines, secure video consultation SDK integrations, speech-to-text transcription pipelines, LMS workflows, and patient vitals tracking.
- Implemented real-time integrations for health wearables, payment gateways (Square API), and third-party EMRs (ModMed).
- Architected multi-channel notification systems (push notifications via Firebase FCM, automated SMS, and transactional email).
- Authored complex PostgreSQL analytical queries and aggregations powering administrative dashboards and research data exports.
- Maintained production uptime, monitored application performance, and resolved critical backend bugs.

### Teaching Assistant
**Company:** FunctionUp
**Period:** March 2022 – October 2022
**Location:** Remote (India)
**Key Contributions:**
- Conducted technical sessions guiding aspiring engineers through JavaScript, Node.js fundamentals, and data structures.
- Reviewed student codebases, providing feedback on code quality, modularity, and algorithmic complexity.
- Guided students through hands-on backend project implementations.

## 4. Key Projects & Platforms

### Cadence (Healthcare Research Platform)
- **Overview:** A cardiovascular health monitoring platform developed in collaboration with Nanyang Technological University (NTU).
- **Core Features:** Real-time patient-coach chat, biometric tracking (sleep, steps, vitals), daily and weekly action scores, medication adherence logging, and researcher analytics dashboards.
- **Tech Stack:** NestJS, PostgreSQL, Sequelize, TypeScript, Firebase, Google BigQuery, Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
- **Store URL:** https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ntu.cadence

### Schweiger Dermatology & Allergy Platform (SDG)
- **Overview:** A patient engagement and clinical operations platform streamlining doctor-patient workflows.
- **Core Features:** ModMed EMR synchronization, Square payment processing for subscriptions and treatments, event-driven architecture using GCP Pub/Sub, real-time messaging, and automated reminders.
- **Tech Stack:** NestJS, PostgreSQL, Socket.IO, GCP Pub/Sub, TypeScript, Square API, ModMed Integration, Firebase.
- **Store URL:** https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mahalo.Schweiger

### MedLinks
- **Overview:** Patient-care platform for delivering personalized wellness programs and remote vitals monitoring.
- **Core Features:** Custom clinician-assigned health tracks, vitals telemetry (blood pressure, glucose, weight), clinician dashboard, and automated alerts.
- **Tech Stack:** NestJS, PostgreSQL, TypeScript, Firebase, GCP.
- **Store URL:** https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mahalo.medlinksclinician

### Hanma (Developer Tooling Platform & CLI)
- **Overview:** An open-source backend utility registry inspired by shadcn/ui, tailored specifically for Node.js and Bun backend developers.
- **Core Features:** Command-line interface to install verified, production-ready backend code snippets (authentication, logger, CORS, rate-limiting, error handling) directly into local projects.
- **Tech Stack:** TypeScript, Node.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS, npm.
- **Repository:** https://github.com/itstheanurag/hanma
- **NPM Package:** https://www.npmjs.com/package/hanma
- **Web App:** https://hanma-a2n.pages.dev/

### Scaffoldor (Project Scaffolding CLI)
- **Overview:** Open-source directory and CLI tool for discovering and bootstrapping starter repositories from GitHub and GitLab without extraneous git history.
- **Tech Stack:** TypeScript, Node.js, Vite, npm.
- **Repository:** https://github.com/itstheanurag/scaffoldor
- **NPM Package:** https://www.npmjs.com/package/scaffoldor
- **Web App:** https://scaffoldor.vercel.app/

### Keyway (Peer-to-Peer File Transfer)
- **Overview:** Browser-based, serverless peer-to-peer file transfer utility.
- **Core Features:** End-to-end encryption with client-generated cryptographic keys, direct WebRTC data channels, zero server-side file persistence or storage.
- **Tech Stack:** Next.js, WebRTC, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
- **Repository:** https://github.com/itstheanurag/keyway
- **Web App:** https://keyway.onrender.com/

### CodeCript (Developer Knowledge Hub)
- **Overview:** Open-source educational platform covering modern software engineering topics.
- **Core Features:** Interactive documentation on TypeScript, Go, data structures, algorithms, and system design.
- **Tech Stack:** Vite, TypeScript, Cloudflare Pages.
- **Repository:** https://github.com/itstheanurag/codecript
- **Web App:** https://codecript.pages.dev/

### Bits & Pieces
- **Overview:** Drop-in UI component library highlighting smooth micro-interactions.
- **Tech Stack:** Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, React.
- **Repository:** https://github.com/itstheanurag/bitsandpieces
